verdict.rationale: The evidence shows multiple scheduling links, each configurable on its own: workflows attach to one or more links, a link can require Stripe payment before the booking is reserved, and per-link conferencing locations (Zoom, Meet, Whereby) and booking caps are available. That covers per-link locations and a payment-based confirmation gate. Missing for 10: explicit per-link duration settings, custom intake questions on booking forms, manual-approval or confirmation rules, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
